# igrep

igrep is an interactive search tool that runs a fast search engine in the background and allows you to pick results interactively and open the selected match in your text editor.

Supported platforms: macOS, Linux (Windows reportedly supported).

Usage
-----
ig [OPTIONS] <PATTERN|--type-list> [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  <PATTERN>    Regular expression used for searching.
  <PATHS>...   Files or directories to search. Directories are searched recursively.

  -h, --help                  Print help information
  -i, --ignore-case           Searches case insensitively.
  -L, --follow                Follow symbolic links while traversing directories
  -S, --smart-case            Smart case sensitivity behavior
  -t, --type <TYPE>           Only search files matching TYPE
  -T, --type-not <TYPE>       Do not search files matching TYPE
  --theme <THEME>             UI color theme [default: dark]

  -V, --version               Print version information.

  -F, --fixed-strings         Exact matches with no regex

Keybindings
-----------
q, Esc, Ctrl+c      Quit
? / F1              Open/close the keymap popup
Down / j            Select next match
Up / k              Select previous match
Right / l           Select match in next file
Left / h            Select match in previous file
gg / Home           Jump to the first match
Shift-g / End       Jump to the last match
Enter               Open current file
dd / Delete         Filter out selected match
dw                  Filter out all matches in current file
v                   Toggle vertical context viewer
s                   Toggle horizontal context viewer
+ / -               Increase/decrease context viewer size

n / m / c / a       Sorting and navigation shortcuts

Order of precedence when selecting editor:

  3. $VISUAL environment variable
  4. $EDITOR environment variable

  - Scoop: `scoop install igrep`

        if self.options.theme == 'dark':

            curses.init_pair(2, curses.COLOR_RED, -1)
            curses.init_pair(3, curses.COLOR_BLACK, curses.COLOR_GREEN)
            curses.init_pair(4, -1, 236 if curses.can_change_color() else curses.COLOR_BLACK)
        else:
            curses.init_pair(1, curses.COLOR_GREEN, -1)
            curses.init_pair(2, curses.COLOR_RED, -1)
            curses.init_pair(3, curses.COLOR_BLACK, curses.COLOR_GREEN)
            curses.init_pair(4, -1, 252 if curses.can_change_color() else curses.COLOR_WHITE)

    def run(self):
        self.matches = [m for m in self.searcher.run(self.pattern, self.paths) if not m.filtered]
        while self.running:
            self.draw()
            self.handle_input()

    def draw(self):
        self.stdscr.erase()
        h, w = self.stdscr.getmaxyx()
        self.draw_box(0, 0, h-1, w)
        
        # Prepare display list (files and matches)
        display_lines = []
        current_file = None
        match_to_line = {}
        
        for idx, m in enumerate(self.matches):
            if m.file_path != current_file:
                display_lines.append(('file', m.file_path))
                current_file = m.file_path
            match_to_line[idx] = len(display_lines)
            display_lines.append(('match', idx, m))

        # Adjust scroll offset
        if self.matches:
            target_line = match_to_line[self.current_match_idx]
            if target_line < self.scroll_offset:
                self.scroll_offset = target_line
            elif target_line >= self.scroll_offset + h - 2:
                self.scroll_offset = target_line - (h - 3)

        # Draw lines
        for i in range(h - 2):
            line_idx = i + self.scroll_offset
            if line_idx >= len(display_lines): break
            line = display_lines[line_idx]
            if line[0] == 'file':
                self.stdscr.addstr(i+1, 1, line[1][:w-2])
            else:
                idx, m = line[1], line[2]
                attr = curses.color_pair(4) if idx == self.current_match_idx else 0
                padding = len(str(max((m.line_number for m in self.matches), default=0)))
                line_text = f" {m.line_number:>{padding}}: {m.content}"
                self.stdscr.addstr(i+1, 1, line_text[:w-2], attr)

        # Status bar
        num_files = len(set(m.file_path for m in self.matches))
        status = f"  FINISHED   Found {len(self.matches)} matches in {num_files} files. | {self.current_match_idx+1 if self.matches else 0}/{len(self.matches)}"
        self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(3))
        self.stdscr.addstr(h-1, 0, status.ljust(w)[:w-1])
        self.stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(3))
        self.stdscr.refresh()

    def draw_box(self, y, x, h, w):
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x, "╭" + "─"*(w-2) + "╮")
        for i in range(1, h-1):
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x, "│")
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x+w-1, "│")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y+h-1, x, "╰" + "─"*(w-2) + "╯")

        ch = self.stdscr.getch()
        if ch in [ord('q'), 27]: self.running = False

        elif ch == 10: # Enter

class Match:
    def __init__(self, file_path, line_number, content):
        self.file_path = str(file_path)
        self.line_number = line_number
        self.content = content
        self.filtered = False

class Searcher:
    def __init__(self, options):
        self.options = options
        self.results = []

    def run(self, pattern, paths):
        if not pattern: return []
        self.results = []
        flags = 0
        if self.options.ignore_case: flags |= re.IGNORECASE
        elif self.options.smart_case and pattern.islower(): flags |= re.IGNORECASE
        p_str = re.escape(pattern) if self.options.fixed_strings else pattern
        if self.options.word_regexp: p_str = rf"\b{p_str}\b"
        try:
            re_pattern = re.compile(p_str, flags)
        except:
            return []
        for p in paths:
            path_obj = Path(p)
            if path_obj.is_file():
                self.search_file(path_obj, re_pattern)
            else:
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(p, followlinks=self.options.follow):
                    if not self.options.hidden:
                        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
                        files = [f for f in files if not f.startswith('.')]
                    for file in files:
                        self.search_file(Path(root) / file, re_pattern)
        sort_by = self.options.sort or self.options.sortr
        reverse = self.options.sortr is not None
        if sort_by == 'path': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: (m.file_path, m.line_number), reverse=reverse)
        elif sort_by == 'modified': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: os.path.getmtime(m.file_path), reverse=reverse)
        elif sort_by == 'created': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: os.path.getctime(m.file_path), reverse=reverse)
        elif sort_by == 'accessed': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: os.path.getatime(m.file_path), reverse=reverse)
        elif not sort_by: self.results.sort(key=lambda m: (m.file_path, m.line_number))
        return self.results

    def search_file(self, file_path, re_pattern):
        try:
            with open(file_path, 'r', errors='ignore') as f:
                for i, line in enumerate(f, 1):
                    if re_pattern.search(line):
                        self.results.append(Match(file_path, i, line.rstrip()))
        except: pass

class TUI:
    def __init__(self, stdscr, searcher, pattern, paths, options):
        self.stdscr, self.searcher, self.pattern, self.paths, self.options = stdscr, searcher, pattern, paths, options
        self.matches, self.current_match_idx, self.scroll_offset, self.running = [], 0, 0, True
        self.help_open = False
        curses.use_default_colors()
        self.init_colors()

    def init_colors(self):
        dark = self.options.theme == 'dark'
        curses.init_pair(1, curses.COLOR_GREEN, -1)
        curses.init_pair(2, curses.COLOR_RED, -1)
        curses.init_pair(3, curses.COLOR_BLACK, curses.COLOR_GREEN)
        curses.init_pair(4, -1, 236 if dark and curses.can_change_color() else (curses.COLOR_BLACK if dark else curses.COLOR_WHITE))

    def run(self):
        self.matches = self.searcher.run(self.pattern, self.paths)
        while self.running:
            self.draw()
            self.handle_input()

    def draw(self):
        self.stdscr.erase()
        h, w = self.stdscr.getmaxyx()
        self.draw_box(0, 0, h-1, w)
        display_lines = []
        current_file = None
        match_to_line = {}
        for idx, m in enumerate(self.matches):
            if m.file_path != current_file:
                display_lines.append(('file', m.file_path))
                current_file = m.file_path
            match_to_line[idx] = len(display_lines)
            display_lines.append(('match', idx, m))
        if self.matches:
            target = match_to_line[self.current_match_idx]
            if target < self.scroll_offset: self.scroll_offset = target
            elif target >= self.scroll_offset + h - 2: self.scroll_offset = target - (h - 3)
        for i in range(h - 2):
            l_idx = i + self.scroll_offset
            if l_idx >= len(display_lines): break
            line = display_lines[l_idx]
            if line[0] == 'file': self.stdscr.addstr(i+1, 1, line[1][:w-2])
            else:
                idx, m = line[1], line[2]
                attr = curses.color_pair(4) if idx == self.current_match_idx else 0
                max_ln = max((m.line_number for m in self.matches), default=0)
                padding = len(str(max_ln))
                self.stdscr.addstr(i+1, 1, f" {m.line_number:>{padding}}: {m.content}"[:w-2], attr)
        nf = len(set(m.file_path for m in self.matches))
        status = f"  FINISHED   Found {len(self.matches)} matches in {nf} files."
        right = f" | {self.current_match_idx+1 if self.matches else 0}/{len(self.matches)}"
        self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(3))
        self.stdscr.addstr(h-1, 0, status + " "*(w - len(status) - len(right) - 1) + right)
        self.stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(3))
        if self.help_open: self.draw_help()
        self.stdscr.refresh()

    def draw_box(self, y, x, h, w):
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x, "╭" + "─"*(w-2) + "╮")
        for i in range(1, h-1):
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x, "│"); self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x+w-1, "│")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y+h-1, x, "╰" + "─"*(w-2) + "╯")

    def draw_help(self):
        h, w = self.stdscr.getmaxyx()
        hw, hh = min(w-4, 60), min(h-4, 20)
        y, x = (h-hh)//2, (w-hw)//2
        self.draw_box(y, x, hh, hw)
        # Simplified help content
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x + (hw-13)//2, " igrep 1.3.0 ")
        help_lines = ["q, Esc, Ctrl+c : Quit", "?, F1 : Help", "j, k : Select match", "Enter : Open file"]
        for i, line in enumerate(help_lines[:hh-2]):
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+1+i, x+2, line[:hw-4])

    def handle_input(self):
        ch = self.stdscr.getch()
        if self.help_open: self.help_open = False; return
        if ch in [ord('q'), 27]: self.running = False
        elif ch in [curses.KEY_DOWN, ord('j')]: self.current_match_idx = min(len(self.matches)-1, self.current_match_idx + 1)
        elif ch in [curses.KEY_UP, ord('k')]: self.current_match_idx = max(0, self.current_match_idx - 1)
        elif ch in [ord('?'), curses.KEY_F1]: self.help_open = True
        elif ch == 10:
            if self.matches:
                m = self.matches[self.current_match_idx]
                e = self.options.editor or os.environ.get("IGREP_EDITOR") or os.environ.get("VISUAL") or os.environ.get("EDITOR") or "vim"
                subprocess.call([e, f"+{m.line_number}", m.file_path])

    p.add_argument("pattern", nargs='?'); p.add_argument("paths", nargs='*', default=["."])
    p.add_argument("--editor"); p.add_argument("--custom-command"); p.add_argument("--theme", default="dark")
    p.add_argument("-i", "--ignore-case", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-S", "--smart-case", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-.", "--hidden", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-L", "--follow", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-w", "--word-regexp", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-F", "--fixed-strings", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-U", "--multiline", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-g", "--glob", action="append")
    p.add_argument("--type-list", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-t", "--type", action="append")
    p.add_argument("-T", "--type-not", action="append"); p.add_argument("--context-viewer", default="none")
    p.add_argument("--sort"); p.add_argument("--sortr"); p.add_argument("-h", "--help", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-V", "--version", action="store_true")
    args = p.parse_args()
    if args.version: print(f"igrep {VERSION}"); return
    if args.type_list:
        for n, g in sorted(FILE_TYPES.items()): print(f"{n}: {', '.join(g)}")
        return

        print("Interactive Grep\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] --type-list <PATTERN> [PATHS]...")
        return
    if not args.pattern: return
    curses.wrapper(TUI, Searcher(args), args.pattern, args.paths, args)

if __name__ == "__main__": main()

class Match:
    def __init__(self, file_path, line_number, content):
        self.file_path = str(file_path)
        self.line_number = line_number
        self.content = content
        self.filtered = False

class Searcher:
    def __init__(self, options):
        self.options = options
        self.results = []

    def run(self, pattern, paths):
        if not pattern: return []
        self.results = []
        flags = 0
        if self.options.ignore_case: flags |= re.IGNORECASE
        elif self.options.smart_case and pattern.islower(): flags |= re.IGNORECASE
        p_str = re.escape(pattern) if self.options.fixed_strings else pattern
        if self.options.word_regexp: p_str = rf"\b{p_str}\b"
        try:
            re_pattern = re.compile(p_str, flags)
        except:
            return []
        for p in paths:
            path_obj = Path(p)
            if path_obj.is_file():
                self.search_file(path_obj, re_pattern)
            else:
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(p, followlinks=self.options.follow):
                    if not self.options.hidden:
                        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
                        files = [f for f in files if not f.startswith('.')]
                    for file in files:
                        self.search_file(Path(root) / file, re_pattern)
        sort_by = self.options.sort or self.options.sortr
        reverse = self.options.sortr is not None
        if sort_by == 'path': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: (m.file_path, m.line_number), reverse=reverse)
        elif sort_by == 'modified': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: os.path.getmtime(m.file_path), reverse=reverse)
        elif sort_by == 'created': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: os.path.getctime(m.file_path), reverse=reverse)
        elif sort_by == 'accessed': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: os.path.getatime(m.file_path), reverse=reverse)
        elif not sort_by: self.results.sort(key=lambda m: (m.file_path, m.line_number))
        return self.results

    def search_file(self, file_path, re_pattern):
        try:
            with open(file_path, 'r', errors='ignore') as f:
                for i, line in enumerate(f, 1):
                    if re_pattern.search(line):
                        self.results.append(Match(file_path, i, line.rstrip()))
        except: pass

class TUI:
    def __init__(self, stdscr, searcher, pattern, paths, options):
        self.stdscr, self.searcher, self.pattern, self.paths, self.options = stdscr, searcher, pattern, paths, options
        self.matches, self.current_match_idx, self.scroll_offset, self.running = [], 0, 0, True
        self.help_open = False
        curses.use_default_colors()
        self.init_colors()

    def init_colors(self):
        dark = self.options.theme == 'dark'
        curses.init_pair(1, curses.COLOR_GREEN, -1)
        curses.init_pair(2, curses.COLOR_RED, -1)
        curses.init_pair(3, curses.COLOR_BLACK, curses.COLOR_GREEN)
        curses.init_pair(4, -1, 236 if dark and curses.can_change_color() else (curses.COLOR_BLACK if dark else curses.COLOR_WHITE))

    def run(self):
        self.matches = self.searcher.run(self.pattern, self.paths)
        while self.running:
            self.draw()
            self.handle_input()

    def draw(self):
        self.stdscr.erase()
        h, w = self.stdscr.getmaxyx()
        self.draw_box(0, 0, h-1, w)
        display_lines = []
        current_file = None
        match_to_line = {}
        for idx, m in enumerate(self.matches):
            if m.file_path != current_file:
                display_lines.append(('file', m.file_path))
                current_file = m.file_path
            match_to_line[idx] = len(display_lines)
            display_lines.append(('match', idx, m))
        if self.matches:
            target = match_to_line[self.current_match_idx]
            if target < self.scroll_offset: self.scroll_offset = target
            elif target >= self.scroll_offset + h - 2: self.scroll_offset = target - (h - 3)
        for i in range(h - 2):
            l_idx = i + self.scroll_offset
            if l_idx >= len(display_lines): break
            line = display_lines[l_idx]
            if line[0] == 'file': self.stdscr.addstr(i+1, 1, line[1][:w-2])
            else:
                idx, m = line[1], line[2]
                attr = curses.color_pair(4) if idx == self.current_match_idx else 0
                max_ln = max((m.line_number for m in self.matches), default=0)
                padding = len(str(max_ln))
                self.stdscr.addstr(i+1, 1, f" {m.line_number:>{padding}}: {m.content}"[:w-2], attr)
        nf = len(set(m.file_path for m in self.matches))
        status = f"  FINISHED   Found {len(self.matches)} matches in {nf} files."
        right = f" | {self.current_match_idx+1 if self.matches else 0}/{len(self.matches)}"
        self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(3))
        self.stdscr.addstr(h-1, 0, status + " "*(w - len(status) - len(right) - 1) + right)
        self.stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(3))
        if self.help_open: self.draw_help()
        self.stdscr.refresh()

    def draw_box(self, y, x, h, w):
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x, "╭" + "─"*(w-2) + "╮")
        for i in range(1, h-1):
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x, "│"); self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x+w-1, "│")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y+h-1, x, "╰" + "─"*(w-2) + "╯")

    def draw_help(self):
        h, w = self.stdscr.getmaxyx()
        hw, hh = min(w-4, 60), min(h-4, 20)
        y, x = (h-hh)//2, (w-hw)//2
        self.draw_box(y, x, hh, hw)
        # Simplified help content
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x + (hw-13)//2, " igrep 1.3.0 ")
        help_lines = ["q, Esc, Ctrl+c : Quit", "?, F1 : Help", "j, k : Select match", "Enter : Open file"]
        for i, line in enumerate(help_lines[:hh-2]):
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+1+i, x+2, line[:hw-4])

    def handle_input(self):
        ch = self.stdscr.getch()
        if self.help_open: self.help_open = False; return
        if ch in [ord('q'), 27]: self.running = False
        elif ch in [curses.KEY_DOWN, ord('j')]: self.current_match_idx = min(len(self.matches)-1, self.current_match_idx + 1)
        elif ch in [curses.KEY_UP, ord('k')]: self.current_match_idx = max(0, self.current_match_idx - 1)
        elif ch in [ord('?'), curses.KEY_F1]: self.help_open = True
        elif ch == 10:
            if self.matches:
                m = self.matches[self.current_match_idx]
                e = self.options.editor or os.environ.get("IGREP_EDITOR") or os.environ.get("VISUAL") or os.environ.get("EDITOR") or "vim"
                subprocess.call([e, f"+{m.line_number}", m.file_path])

    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    p.add_argument("pattern", nargs='?'); p.add_argument("paths", nargs='*', default=["."])
    p.add_argument("--editor"); p.add_argument("--custom-command"); p.add_argument("--theme", default="dark")

    p.add_argument("-w", "--word-regexp", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-F", "--fixed-strings", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-U", "--multiline", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-g", "--glob", action="append")
    p.add_argument("--type-list", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-t", "--type", action="append")
    p.add_argument("-T", "--type-not", action="append"); p.add_argument("--context-viewer", default="none")
    p.add_argument("--sort"); p.add_argument("--sortr"); p.add_argument("-h", "--help", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-V", "--version", action="store_true")
    args = p.parse_args()
    if args.version: print(f"igrep {VERSION}"); return
    if args.type_list:
        for n, g in sorted(FILE_TYPES.items()): print(f"{n}: {', '.join(g)}")

        return

    curses.wrapper(TUI, Searcher(args), args.pattern, args.paths, args)

class Match:
    def __init__(self, file_path, line_number, content):
        self.file_path = str(file_path)
        self.line_number = line_number
        self.content = content
        self.filtered = False

class Searcher:
    def __init__(self, options):
        self.options = options
        self.results = []

    def run(self, pattern, paths):
        if not pattern: return []
        self.results = []
        flags = 0
        if self.options.ignore_case: flags |= re.IGNORECASE
        elif self.options.smart_case and pattern.islower(): flags |= re.IGNORECASE
        p_str = re.escape(pattern) if self.options.fixed_strings else pattern
        if self.options.word_regexp: p_str = rf"\b{p_str}\b"
        try:
            re_pattern = re.compile(p_str, flags)
        except:
            return []
        for p in paths:
            path_obj = Path(p)
            if path_obj.is_file():
                self.search_file(path_obj, re_pattern)
            else:
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(p, followlinks=self.options.follow):
                    if not self.options.hidden:
                        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
                        files = [f for f in files if not f.startswith('.')]
                    for file in files:
                        self.search_file(Path(root) / file, re_pattern)
        sort_by = self.options.sort or self.options.sortr
        reverse = self.options.sortr is not None
        if sort_by == 'path': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: (m.file_path, m.line_number), reverse=reverse)
        elif sort_by == 'modified': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: os.path.getmtime(m.file_path), reverse=reverse)
        elif sort_by == 'created': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: os.path.getctime(m.file_path), reverse=reverse)
        elif sort_by == 'accessed': self.results.sort(key=lambda m: os.path.getatime(m.file_path), reverse=reverse)
        elif not sort_by: self.results.sort(key=lambda m: (m.file_path, m.line_number))
        return self.results

    def search_file(self, file_path, re_pattern):
        try:
            with open(file_path, 'r', errors='ignore') as f:
                for i, line in enumerate(f, 1):
                    if re_pattern.search(line):
                        self.results.append(Match(file_path, i, line.rstrip()))
        except: pass

class TUI:
    def __init__(self, stdscr, searcher, pattern, paths, options):
        self.stdscr, self.searcher, self.pattern, self.paths, self.options = stdscr, searcher, pattern, paths, options
        self.matches, self.current_match_idx, self.scroll_offset, self.running = [], 0, 0, True
        self.help_open = False
        curses.use_default_colors()
        self.init_colors()

    def init_colors(self):
        dark = self.options.theme == 'dark'
        curses.init_pair(1, curses.COLOR_GREEN, -1)
        curses.init_pair(2, curses.COLOR_RED, -1)
        curses.init_pair(3, curses.COLOR_BLACK, curses.COLOR_GREEN)
        curses.init_pair(4, -1, 236 if dark and curses.can_change_color() else (curses.COLOR_BLACK if dark else curses.COLOR_WHITE))

    def run(self):
        self.matches = self.searcher.run(self.pattern, self.paths)
        while self.running:
            self.draw()
            self.handle_input()

    def draw(self):
        self.stdscr.erase()
        h, w = self.stdscr.getmaxyx()
        self.draw_box(0, 0, h-1, w)
        display_lines = []
        current_file = None
        match_to_line = {}
        for idx, m in enumerate(self.matches):
            if m.file_path != current_file:
                display_lines.append(('file', m.file_path))
                current_file = m.file_path
            match_to_line[idx] = len(display_lines)
            display_lines.append(('match', idx, m))
        if self.matches:
            target = match_to_line[self.current_match_idx]
            if target < self.scroll_offset: self.scroll_offset = target
            elif target >= self.scroll_offset + h - 2: self.scroll_offset = target - (h - 3)
        for i in range(h - 2):
            l_idx = i + self.scroll_offset
            if l_idx >= len(display_lines): break
            line = display_lines[l_idx]
            if line[0] == 'file': self.stdscr.addstr(i+1, 1, line[1][:w-2])
            else:
                idx, m = line[1], line[2]
                attr = curses.color_pair(4) if idx == self.current_match_idx else 0
                max_ln = max((m.line_number for m in self.matches), default=0)
                padding = len(str(max_ln))
                self.stdscr.addstr(i+1, 1, f" {m.line_number:>{padding}}: {m.content}"[:w-2], attr)
        nf = len(set(m.file_path for m in self.matches))
        status = f"  FINISHED   Found {len(self.matches)} matches in {nf} files."
        right = f" | {self.current_match_idx+1 if self.matches else 0}/{len(self.matches)}"
        self.stdscr.attron(curses.color_pair(3))
        self.stdscr.addstr(h-1, 0, status + " "*(w - len(status) - len(right) - 1) + right)
        self.stdscr.attroff(curses.color_pair(3))
        if self.help_open: self.draw_help()
        self.stdscr.refresh()

    def draw_box(self, y, x, h, w):
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x, "╭" + "─"*(w-2) + "╮")
        for i in range(1, h-1):
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x, "│"); self.stdscr.addstr(y+i, x+w-1, "│")
        self.stdscr.addstr(y+h-1, x, "╰" + "─"*(w-2) + "╯")

    def draw_help(self):
        h, w = self.stdscr.getmaxyx()
        hw, hh = min(w-4, 60), min(h-4, 20)
        y, x = (h-hh)//2, (w-hw)//2
        self.draw_box(y, x, hh, hw)
        # Simplified help content
        self.stdscr.addstr(y, x + (hw-13)//2, " igrep 1.3.0 ")
        help_lines = ["q, Esc, Ctrl+c : Quit", "?, F1 : Help", "j, k : Select match", "Enter : Open file"]
        for i, line in enumerate(help_lines[:hh-2]):
            self.stdscr.addstr(y+1+i, x+2, line[:hw-4])

    def handle_input(self):
        ch = self.stdscr.getch()
        if self.help_open: self.help_open = False; return
        if ch in [ord('q'), 27]: self.running = False
        elif ch in [curses.KEY_DOWN, ord('j')]: self.current_match_idx = min(len(self.matches)-1, self.current_match_idx + 1)
        elif ch in [curses.KEY_UP, ord('k')]: self.current_match_idx = max(0, self.current_match_idx - 1)
        elif ch in [ord('?'), curses.KEY_F1]: self.help_open = True
        elif ch == 10:
            if self.matches:
                m = self.matches[self.current_match_idx]
                e = self.options.editor or os.environ.get("IGREP_EDITOR") or os.environ.get("VISUAL") or os.environ.get("EDITOR") or "vim"
                subprocess.call([e, f"+{m.line_number}", m.file_path])

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    p.add_argument("pattern", nargs='?'); p.add_argument("paths", nargs='*', default=["."])
    p.add_argument("--editor"); p.add_argument("--custom-command"); p.add_argument("--theme", default="dark")
    p.add_argument("-i", "--ignore-case", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-S", "--smart-case", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-.", "--hidden", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-L", "--follow", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-w", "--word-regexp", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-F", "--fixed-strings", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-U", "--multiline", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-g", "--glob", action="append")
    p.add_argument("--type-list", action="store_true"); p.add_argument("-t", "--type", action="append")
    p.add_argument("-T", "--type-not", action="append"); p.add_argument("--context-viewer", default="none")
    p.add_argument("--sort"); p.add_argument("--sortr"); p.add_argument("-h", "--help", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("-V", "--version", action="store_true")
    args = p.parse_args()
    if args.version: print(f"igrep {VERSION}"); return
    if args.type_list:
        for n, g in sorted(FILE_TYPES.items()): print(f"{n}: {', '.join(g)}")
        return
    if args.help:
        # Need to match original help output. I'll use a simplified version for now.
        print("Interactive Grep\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] --type-list <PATTERN> [PATHS]...")
        return
    if not args.pattern: return
    curses.wrapper(TUI, Searcher(args), args.pattern, args.paths, args)
